title: The Lemonade Stirred and Poured
youtube_title: The Lemonade Stirred and Poured | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Two careful pairs of hands can do what one rush cannot.
summary: At a harbor dock where baskets are passed up, a lemonade stirred by one and poured by the other will go wrong if one person rushes. Esme and Teo split it into two slow jobs, while Uncle Idris only offers a count or a name for the knot they need. They finish together.
